results.pair_summary: Both documents define the World entity, its lifecycle states, and core operations (make-world, fork-world, kernel-commit-world!, replay-world). Document A is a broader 'Runtime Observation Contract' including Registry management and observation types (WorldObs), while Document B focuses strictly on the internal IR type definitions and invariants of the World structure.
results.integration_rationale: Document A serves as the canonical architectural contract for the Delta3 Kernel's runtime interface. Document B contains specific IR implementation details (e.g., head-cell vs head, Shared refs) that must be reconciled into the Contract to ensure type safety and semantic consistency between the Kernel API and the underlying World IR. Merging B into A preserves the broader Registry/Observation context while refining the World definition.
